14337488.sourceDescription:
Celebrate the holidays in grand style with this 8ft Pre-lit Resin Candy Cane Nutcracker. Crafted from durable polyresin and accented with 42 multicolour LED lights, it plays 8 classic holiday tunes to add festive charm to any space. Designed for both indoor and outdoor use, it includes a removable staff, AC adapter, and easy assembly. The rich hand-painted finish and oversized design make it a standout holiday centerpiece. Built to last, this nutcracker combines tradition with modern functionality.
Oversized 8-Foot Holiday Showpiece – Create a magical Christmas display with this stunning 8ft Candy Cane Nutcracker. Designed to impress both day and night, the rich hand-painted detailing and grand scale make it the ultimate festive focal point for homes, gardens, shops, entrances and holiday events.
Pre-Lit with 42 Multicolour LED Lights – Comes fully pre-lit with 42 vibrant LEDs that bring bold brilliance and festive colour to your décor. Bright, energy efficient LED lighting ensures long lasting seasonal illumination with minimal maintenance.
Plays 8 Classic Christmas Melodies – Built-in sound function plays 8 popular holiday tunes to add warmth, nostalgia and family joy to your Christmas experience. Simply plug in and enjoy a fully immersive seasonal atmosphere.
Indoor & Outdoor Safe Construction – Made from weather resistant polyresin/stone material suitable for both interior and exterior holiday decorating. Strong, durable and built to withstand seasonal conditions while maintaining colour & detail year after year.
Easy Set Up & Complete With Accessories – Includes removable candy cane staff, 120V AC adapter and long 32 ft (10 m) power cord for flexible placement. Ideal for living rooms, porches, storefronts, lobbies, gardens, malls and party displays.
Guarantee - 1 year

Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and metal and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Warm White Light
Warm white illumination gives the display a softer colour tone. It can be paired with surrounding decorative lighting to create a coordinated appearance in the intended setting.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

Plan the display

Constructed from durable metal and plastic with a vibrant green finish for lasting use.

Snowy elegance: Bring the magic of a winter wonderland indoors with this snow Christmas tree set. The downswept shape with 86/112/161 flocked tips, creates the look of leaves gently weighed down by fresh snow, adding a serene, natural charm.
Three-piece set: This set includes three different sized frosted Christmas trees (3 ft, 4 ft, 5 ft), designed to stand alone or be combined as a stunning grouped display, suitable for creating a beautifully layered festive display throughout your home.

Fire-resistant: Crafted from flame-retardant flocking and plastic, those thin Christmas trees ensure your family can enjoy the festive season safely even near the fireplace, without compromising on style.

Artificial Christmas Tree
This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

0851158008888.sourceDescription: Turn a blank canvas into a one-of-a-kind keepsake with Sleetly DIY White Christmas Baubles. This set of 12 matte white baubles to paint gives crafters, hobbyists, and families everything they need to design personalized holiday decorations. Each round bauble measures 3.15 inches (80mm) wide, offering a generous, smooth surface that takes acrylic paint, paint markers, adhesive vinyl, stickers, glue, glitter, and beads with ease. The matte finish grips color evenly with no slick glare, so painted baubles turn out bold, crisp, and professional. Unlike fragile glass, these plastic bauble baubles are shatterproof, so they won't crack if dropped during crafting, gifting, or storage, making them ideal for group projects and busy craft tables. Every blank bauble comes fitted with an upgraded metal cap and ribbon hanger, so your finished design is ready to hang on the tree the moment the paint dries. Paint your own snowman, monogram a family name, or create matching sets for gifts, party favors, and year-after-year keepsakes. These paintable white blanks are perfect for holiday craft nights, DIY bauble kits, and personalized tree decor. Combine with other Sleetly colors, sizes and styles to expand your collection, or add more sets to build the fullness you want on your tree. From plain white blanks to painted showpieces, Sleetly makes DIY Christmas crafting simple, safe, and fun.May contain small parts. Not suitable for children under 3 years. Keep out of reach of pets. Do not hang within reach of children or pets. Avoid contact with heat sources.

8941467526288.baseName: 6.6 ft Christmas Snow Globe String Lights 10 LED Vintage Bulbs with Pine and Snow Ornaments for Mantel Fireplace
8941467526288.variantName: 6.6 ft Christmas Snow Globe String Lights 10 LED Vintage Bulbs with Pine and Snow Ornaments for Mantel Fireplace
8941467526288.sourceDescription:
Bring a vintage Christmas feel to any room with this 6.6 ft (2 m) string light, supplied with 10 LED snow globe bulbs. Each bulb measures 1.34 x 3.15 in and is filled with delicate faux pine, snow and small ornaments, so the garland still looks decorated when the lights are switched off. The clear globes let the pine and snow scene read in daylight as well as after dark.

The globes are made from high quality acrylic rather than glass, which makes them lighter, more durable and safer around children and pets, and gives them a waterproof finish that copes with damp evenings outside. The set runs on 3 AA batteries (not included), so there is no cable to route and you can hang it on a mantel, window, curtain rail or porch rail without needing a socket nearby. A switch on the battery box lets you pick between steady and flashing modes.

Use it indoors in the bedroom, living room, kitchen or dining room, or outdoors on a patio, in a corridor, at a school event or in a shop window. Ten warm bulbs are enough for a mantelpiece, a small tree or a doorway, and the battery power means you can move the light around the house as the decorations change.

If an ornament inside a bulb shifts during transit, gently shake the bulb or unscrew it and straighten the figure with tweezers. Store the light loosely coiled to protect the acrylic globes between seasons.

3622392484588.sourceDescription:
1. Core Specifications
Size: 90cm in diameter. The round shape fits most small to medium Christmas trees, providing full coverage for the base without overwhelming smaller spaces.
Function: 2-in-1 design. It acts as a Christmas tree skirt to dress up the base, and doubles as a small rug to add softness underfoot around the tree area.
Decor Focus: Tree base decoration. It targets the "empty" space under the tree, turning plain stands into a cohesive part of your overall Christmas decor.
2. Festive & Practical Highlights
Hide Unsightly Stands: Completely covers plastic or metal tree stands, eliminating visual clutter and making your Christmas tree look more polished and put-together.
Boost Holiday Vibe: Whether it’s paired with lights, ornaments, or wrapped gifts, the skirt adds a classic festive element. It complements all tree styles—from traditional green to flocked or colored trees.
Protect Floors: Beyond decoration, it acts as a barrier between the tree stand and your floor. It prevents scratches on wood or tile, and catches fallen pine needles (for real trees) or small decor debris.
3. User-Friendly Details
Easy to Use: Most styles feature a split design with simple fasteners (like Velcro or ties). Just wrap it around the tree base, secure it, and it’s ready—no tools needed.
Lightweight & Storable: Thin yet durable material folds flat for easy storage after Christmas. It takes up minimal space and can be reused year after year.
Versatile Placement: While designed for tree bases, it can also be used as a small accent rug near fireplaces or entryways to extend festive decor to other parts of your home.

5096042276188.baseName: Christmas welcome wreath - Woven wooden door sign with Father Christmas, a reindeer and a tree for a seasonal entrance - 25 cm
5096042276188.variantName: Christmas welcome wreath - Woven wooden door sign with Father Christmas, a reindeer and a tree for a seasonal entrance - 25 cm
5096042276188.sourceDescription:
Father Christmas, a reindeer and a tree sit together on this woven wooden door decoration. The word WELCOME makes it especially well suited to an entrance, where the small scene can greet visitors at eye level. At 25 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

The greeting gives the wreath a clear role at an entrance. The small Christmas scene adds detail around the words, so the sign works at two distances, first as a welcome and then as a picture to see while standing at the door.

When dressing an entrance, allow for the full movement of the door as well as the width of the decoration. Set it clear of the handle, letter plate and frame so the arrangement stays in position as people come and go. A plain background lets you see the smaller details even from the other side of the room. Try holding the wreath against a light wall and then against a darker door before fixing the hanging point.

For a wall arrangement, try the wreath above a narrow console with the centre of the design just below eye level. A clear strip of wall between the wreath and the furniture shows off the outline and leaves the surface free for keys or Christmas cards. Hung on a panelled door, a wreath looks best when the edges of the panel still show. Centre it on the panel itself and look at it from the far end of the hall before choosing the final hanging height.

On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct. If you already have a busy Christmas tree, give the wreath a space of its own. A quiet patch of wall brings the outline into focus and gives visitors a chance to see the individual details as they pass.
Woven wooden construction featuring festive Father Christmas, reindeer and tree motifs for a charming seasonal display.
Compact 25 cm diameter size allows easy placement on doors or walls without obstructing handles or letter plates.
Clear 'WELCOME' lettering combined with detailed holiday imagery creates an inviting greeting visible from multiple distances.
Versatile design suitable for hanging on panelled doors, mantels or walls to enhance your Christmas entrance decor.

5492566454888.sourceDescription: Fifteen metres covers a staircase, a marquee or a long table, which is why this length is more useful than a short garland that only does a mantelpiece. After the holidays, pack everything away in its original box or a sturdy container, wrapped in tissue so delicate parts are cushioned, and store it somewhere cool and dry. 5313817006888.sourceDescription:
Product Overview

 Artificial snow‑flocked Christmas garland made of flame‑retardant PVC pine needles, decorated with pine cones and bright red berries. 
 Available in 1.8m(6ft) and 2.7m(9ft) lengths, two versions: pre‑lit with LED lights and unlit without lights. 
 The pre‑lit version comes with battery‑operated 3m warm‑white LED string lights (battery box, NO timer function, AA batteries not included). 
 Ideal for indoor & covered outdoor Christmas holiday decoration.

Common Specs for all variants

 Material: Flame‑retardant PVC pine branches, artificial pine cones, plastic red berries, snow flocking coating
 Style: Snow‑flocked frosted finish, classic Christmas decorative elements with pinecone & red berry ornaments
 Installation: Bendable branches, you can adjust and shape the garland freely to fit different scenes
 Application: Indoor and covered outdoor use

Version 1: Unlit Garland (No LED Lights)
Available lengths:

 1.8m / 6ft unlit garland
 2.7m / 9ft unlit garlandFeatures: Flexible bendable pine branches; you can add your own string lights as needed. Great for DIY holiday decor.

Application Scenarios

 Stair railings, banisters
 Fireplace mantel, hearth
 Front door frame, porch, window trim
 Archway, entryway, wall hanging
 Holiday party, shop window, café Christmas display
 Covered patio, covered outdoor eaves

Notes & Precautions

 For indoor and covered outdoor use only. Do not expose to heavy rain or standing water.
 Keep away from open flame and high‑temperature heat sources, even though the material is flame‑retardant.
REALISTIC SNOW-COVERED DESIGN: This Christmas wreath features lifelike snow-laden pine branches. The white “snow” complements the green needles beautifully, while natural-textured pine cones and vibrant red berries create an authentic winter wonderland scene. Instantly bringing the enchanting atmosphere of a Christmas forest into your home, it perfectly complements the festive spirit.
VERSATILE DECORATIVE USES:With dimensions suitable for various spaces (available in lengths of 1.8 metres / 70.87 inches, 2.7 metres / 106.3 inches, etc., and a width of 30 centimetres / 11.82 inches), this wreath is exceptionally practical. Hang it over your mantelpiece, drape it along banisters, adorn your fireplace surround, or use it to decorate doorways and windows. It integrates seamlessly into both indoor and sheltered outdoor Christmas displays, adding festive magic wherever it graces.
DURABLE AND REUSABLE:Crafted from premium materials, this garland is built to last. Its sturdy construction ensures it retains its shape and vibrant appearance year after year. Unlike real foliage, it won't shed needles and requires no maintenance, making it a convenient and enduring choice for Christmas decor that you can enjoy for many festive seasons to come.
EASY TO INSTALL AND STORE: Lightweight and flexible, the garland is effortless to hang. Secure it simply with hooks or cable ties, or lay it directly in place. After the festive season, it rolls or folds neatly, taking up minimal storage space for convenient preservation until next Christmas. This hassle-free storage and installation saves you time and effort.
IDEAL FOR CREATING FESTIVE AMBIENCE: Whether decorating for family gatherings, holiday parties, or simply wishing to immerse yourself in Christmas spirit, this garland is the perfect choice. The combination of snowflakes, pinecones, and berries evokes warmth, joy, and nostalgia, instantly transforming your space into a delightful festive haven.
Guarantee - 1 month

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Colour: Red. Stated size: 53 x 27 x 120 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Features a recognisable Father Christmas motif for festive character.
Constructed from durable fabric with a vibrant red finish.
Compact dimensions of 53 x 27 x 120 cm suit various displays.
Versatile design allows easy placement within holiday arrangements.

The adapter should be plugged into an indoor or dry location to protect the power source from moisture. 5059442204588.sourceDescription:
With its classic Christmas-tree shape and naturally dense growth, a pot-grown Fraser Fir makes a traditional choice for the festive season while offering something extra beyond December. The rich green foliage forms neat layers of branches that are easy to decorate, while the short, soft needles and good needle retention help it remain an attractive feature throughout the celebrations. This real Christmas tree has also been grown in a pot from the outset, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container before sale.
CLASSIC CHRISTMAS CHARACTER: Naturally conical and densely branched, Fraser Fir has the traditional Christmas-tree shape many people look for, with rich green foliage that creates a full appearance without needing excessive decoration. The branches provide plenty of room for lights, baubles, and other festive favourites.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
SOFT NEEDLES, LASTING DISPLAY: Fraser Fir has relatively soft needles that are pleasant to handle when decorating, while its needle retention helps it maintain a full appearance throughout the festive period. The foliage also releases a fresh, characteristic fir fragrance, adding another familiar part of the real Christmas tree experience.
FROM CHRISTMAS TREE TO GARDEN TREE: Once Christmas is over, move your real tree back outdoors and continue caring for it as it grows. Fraser Firs are excellent evergreen trees for garden, bringing year-round foliage and structure rather than having its role end when the decorations come down.
ENJOY IT AGAIN IN YEARS TO COME: Caring for a pot-grown tree between Christmases gives it the opportunity to return to your home for future celebrations. Keep it growing outdoors during the rest of the year, and this potted real Christmas tree can become a Christmas tradition that grows with you, rather than a tree bought and replaced each season.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory
